target: NAVER Detail to Spring Recommendation serving projection

projectionLayers.detail: Verified provider-source rows; not itself Spring serving readiness
projectionLayers.servingProjection: Typed values consumed by Spring candidate filter/rank/response
projectionLayers.semanticProfile: Evidence-backed AI retrieval features; separate from serving projection

category.java: nullable RestaurantCategory enum: KOREAN, KOREAN_SOUP, SALAD
sourceCandidates: NAVER HOME crawler category (currently captured but not persisted)
category.projection: UNRESOLVED; no validated provider-to-enum crosswalk; raw provider category is not enum-safe
category.recommendedDirection: Versioned category catalog/crosswalk with UNKNOWN/REVIEW state, not an expanding enum or restaurant-ID rules

representativeMenu.source: active MENU SUCCESS NAVER rows; current crawler persists names/descriptions/prices but no separate representative marker field
representativeMenu.projection: UNRESOLVED unless a unique explicit provider representative/signature marker identifies one eligible item
representativeMenu.recommendedDirection: Prefer source-labelled list of menu highlights; scalar only for a unique verified marker

price.projection: UNRESOLVED for hard lunch budget; heterogeneous all-menu mean/median is not single-person meal price
price.recommendedDirection: Structured eligible meal-price candidates/range with explicit basis and serving-size evidence; budget policy must use only classified meal items

schedule.source: MENU-independent BUSINESS_HOURS SUCCESS, source-grounded active hour records
schedule.projection: UNRESOLVED pending interval/day grouping, break parsing, overnight/24h and exception-date policy

recommendationReady.meaning: all required, current Spring serving projection data passed its validation policy
predicateProposal: weekly hours and closures faithfully normalized
recommendationReady.owner: Spring ServingProjectionService/batch; Python collector remains source ingestion and preview producer

options.categoryDirectProvider: Do not copy raw hierarchy directly into the Java enum; incompatible vocabularies and mismatched provider categories.
options.categoryLLM: Suggestion-only future option with controlled schema, evidence and review; no model calls in this task.
options.categoryModel: Recommended long-term: taxonomy IDs/catalog/crosswalk, stable API/preferences, unknown/review workflow.
options.promotionOwner: Spring is authoritative for its MySQL serving data and recommendation semantics; Python may emit a read-only projection preview.
options.gemini: PLANNED_GEMINI_CANDIDATE for constrained broad-category suggestion only; not implemented/called here.
